label: Audit history
description: A read-only, append-only timeline of every field change on a record: what changed (old → new), when, by which actor — a user, an AI agent acting for a user, or a module/automation — and under which configuration revision. Use it in a History tab so people can see how a record got to its current state.
usage: Place in a dedicated History tab of the record view.
Keep the default pageSize unless records change very often.
constraints: Read-only and append-only: entries cannot be edited or deleted through any API.
Visible to viewers with the audit.read action or read access to the record; values of fields the viewer cannot read are shown as "Restricted".
pageSize is 10–100 (default 25); history is paged on the server, newest first.

binding.description: Reads the audit log of the page's record, redacted by field permissions.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab enters the list; Up/Down move between entries; Enter expands an entry's full diff.
accessibility.notes: Each entry reads as a sentence: "Ana Ruiz changed Priority from P3 to P2, 10 Oct 14:30, revision 42".

responsive: Old and new values stack below 720px.
